title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-07-17
source: SBD > RTR @ 15 I.p.s. > PCM > D > SSSB

ai_review.summary: Superb Bear‑recorded soundboard captures an early‑66 garage‑rock set with rare gems like “In the Pines”, delivering solid performance despite modest energy.
ai_review.review: The tape, likely cut from Owsley ‘Bear’ Stanley’s soundboard, is praised as crisp and superb, offering one of the few surviving windows onto the Dead’s July 1966 shows. Musically the concert showcases the raw garage‑band style of that era with standout moments such as “In the Pines”, though listeners note it isn’t as high‑octane as some other 1966 dates.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple detailed reviews rate the recording 4–5 stars and highlight good to excellent audio quality; show is viewed as solid with rare material, yielding an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear sound typical of Bear's tapes; no major drop‑outs or muffiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑summer 1966 set features garage‑rock material, largely overlapping with the July 16 show; cohesive but not exceptionally dynamic.
